profile_text.body:
Inceptive describes itself as building foundation models of life, models that extrapolate from data to design medicines for humanity's most challenging diseases. The company is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. It describes its team as antedisciplinary, made up of scientists, AI researchers, and engineers who work together on "the beach" where wet and dry meet, and says it is hiring scientists and engineers across AI and bio.

On its own account, the company believes AI models can do the greatest good by learning the mechanisms of life and designing novel therapies, and it describes its work as optimizing black box models for medicine. It says it views partnerships as strategic alliances, working over time to tune models, use data, and transfer knowledge, and invites discussion of how its team and technology can optimize an AI investment and pipeline. No products from the company are tracked in the record.

The record lists no litigation cases for Inceptive. Its legal exposure is recorded in California, and no MCP servers are listed for it.
